errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a logarithmic scale. The intervals between tick marks (e.g., 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8) are not spaced logarithmically.

errors.text_span: Vanilla (purple, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid, no markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid, no markers)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that none of the lines have markers. In the figure, each line has a distinct marker style: Vanilla has triangles, SepLLM (n=64) has vertical lines, SepLLM (n=128) has crosses, SepLLM (n=64, H) has diamonds, and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) has circles.
The purple 'Vanilla' line is constant at 100%, not 99.9%.
For the SepLLM (n=64) line, the value at 3e8 TFLOPs is approximately 100%, not 99.7%.
For the SepLLM (n=64) line, the final value at 9e8 TFLOPs is approximately 100%, not 99.5%.
For the SepLLM (n=128) line, the value at 2e8 TFLOPs is approximately 99.8%, not 99.5%.
The SepLLM (n=128) line does not remain steady after 2e8 TFLOPs; it fluctuates between approximately 99.6% and 99.8%.
The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, not 98.5%.

errors.text_span: increases to around 99.6% at $2 \cdot 10^8$ TFLOPs before decreasing slightly
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the SepLLM (n=64, H) line is incorrect. The line continues to increase after 2e8 TFLOPs, peaking at 6e8 TFLOPs, it does not decrease after 2e8 TFLOPs.
For the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line, the value at 3e8 TFLOPs is approximately 98.5%, not 99%. The line peaks closer to 4e8 TFLOPs.
